scientific_integrity: The universal assertions use an analytical proof. Finite arithmetic and floating-point frequency tests are consistency checks, not exhaustive proof. No independent audit or certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Large-degree asymptotic restricted to 9m<=N<=91m/10, no effective minimum degree, no threshold-equality nonlinear claim. The existing continuum and finite Fourier criteria are prior work; bibliographic priority needs independent checking.
title: Sharp finite-size transition for three-twisted rotating waves in a directed Kuramoto ring
